system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:23 UTC, WS-LMARTINS-01 recorded explicit use of svc-render credentials by Meridian OpsAgent to target PROXY-NWD-01. This is outside the documented RenderQueue workflow and is suspicious, particularly because svc-render is a service account for a job on FILE-NWD-01.

At 13:56 UTC, WS-NBLAKE-01 recorded explicit use of svc-render credentials by Meridian OpsAgent to target FILE-NWD-01. The available context does not describe this as an approved help-desk action or workflow.

FILE-NWD-01 repeatedly failed network logons for svc-render, with incorrect-password status, at roughly one-minute intervals from 13:36 through 13:51 UTC. The records identify the workstation as FILE-NWD-01 and the process as lsass.exe; corresponding domain-controller records also show authentication failures.

The one-minute failure pattern is consistent with the documented RenderQueue job continuing to authenticate with a stale password after the scheduled 13:30 UTC rotation. This explains the repeated failures but does not explain the separate explicit-credential events from WS-LMARTINS-01 and WS-NBLAKE-01.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show explicit-credential events, but do not establish whether authentication to either target succeeded.
The records do not show what launched Meridian OpsAgent, its command line, its configuration, or whether it is authorized in this environment.
The supplied window contains no process execution, network connection, or subsequent logon-session evidence to establish what activity followed the explicit-credential events.
claims_not_established: Whether the explicit credential attempts from WS-LMARTINS-01 and WS-NBLAKE-01 succeeded.
Whether Meridian OpsAgent is legitimate software or was used by an authorized operator.
Who initiated or controlled the activity on either workstation.
Whether svc-render credentials were exposed, misused successfully, or used to access data or systems.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect successful and failed logon records on PROXY-NWD-01 and FILE-NWD-01 around 13:23 and 13:56 UTC, including session and source details.
Obtain endpoint process, command-line, parent-process, and network telemetry for Meridian OpsAgent on WS-LMARTINS-01 and WS-NBLAKE-01.
Verify whether Meridian OpsAgent is approved, how it is managed, and whether there was an authorized task involving svc-render on either workstation.
Review svc-render password-rotation records and RenderQueue configuration/update history to confirm the timing and scope of the stale-password failures.
